jade__sword_dance.title: Sword Dance
jade__sword_dance.description: Unlocks Sword Dance (Level 3) (36 mana, 135 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__sword_dance.extra_description: Summoning magical swords around the caster. After a short delay, the swords will fly toward the last hurt target and stab them

jade__bagua_array_circle.title: Bagua Array Circle
jade__bagua_array_circle.description: Unlocks Bagua Array Circle (Level 3) (65 mana, 90 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__bagua_array_circle.extra_description: Summon a Bagua Circle at designated area, damaging undead mob inside and give its owner Reversal Healing effect

jade__drapes_of_reflection.title: Drapes Of Reflection
jade__drapes_of_reflection.description: Unlocks Drapes Of Reflection (Level 3) (34 mana, 45 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__drapes_of_reflection.extra_description: Create a magical Jade Drape, deflect any projectile hit it

jade__punishing_heaven.title: Punishing Heaven
jade__punishing_heaven.description: Unlocks Punishing Heaven (Level 1) (180 mana, 320 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__punishing_heaven.extra_description: Summon a Jade Executioner, a great warrior that will behead anything that's against you or the Celestial Court

jade__meditation.title: Meditation
jade__meditation.description: Teaches Meditation, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Sneak still for 2 s to meditate; the longer you meditate, the longer the buff (stage 1: +40% damage; stage 2: +30% attack speed and Speed I; stage 3: 50% less damage taken and Regeneration I). Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
jade__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__damage_boost1.title: Strength I
jade__damage_boost1.description: Teaches Strength I, an Epic Fight Passive skill: A perfect parry grants Strength I for 2 s. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__desert_wrath.title: Desert Wrath
jade__desert_wrath.description: Unlocks Desert Wrath (Level 2) (86 mana, 90 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__desert_wrath.extra_description: Summons tornadoes around you that deal damage on impact.

jade__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
jade__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__phantom_ascent.title: Phantom Ascent
jade__phantom_ascent.description: Teaches Phantom Ascent, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Jump again in mid-air. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__symmetry_empowerment.title: Symmetry Empowerment
jade__symmetry_empowerment.description: Unlocks Symmetry Empowerment (Level 3) (72 mana, 60 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__symmetry_empowerment.extra_description: Applies Symmetry Empowerment to yourself, granting Symmetry Spell Power bonus.

jade__underworld_aid.title: Impermanence's Verdict
jade__underworld_aid.description: Unlocks Impermanence's Verdict (Level 1) (130 mana, 160 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
jade__underworld_aid.extra_description: Calling upon 4 Impermanence to verdict targets in a circle, apply slowness, blindness, darkness effect and damage them for 4 second. The damage will scale based on the lost health of the target, up to target's 40% max health

jade__parry_master.title: Parry Master
jade__parry_master.description: Teaches Parry Master, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Parries charge your weapon skill and build up a chance to ignore enemy defence; with a katana, parries open Ichimonji counters. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

jade__planned_jade_barrage.title: Jade Barrage
